## The question

[Looking for LaTeX templates.](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/18059/looking-for-latex-templates), asked by [K_K](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/5488/k-k) on TeX Stack Exchange (2011-05-12; [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/)):

> where can I find a 'professional' document templates in LaTeX. I need two different one to the other user documentation and second for developer documentation. I know that I can safely create it myself, but I have no idea of ​​the appearance of these documents.
:::

[CTAN](http://ctan.org/) is the Comprehensive TeX Archive Network.  You might try looking at some of the [alternative document classes](http://texcatalogue.sarovar.org/bytopic.html#classes) there.
